rule: rule 2 at the reversal's signal close on TradingView's money, whatever rests in the book: E = (IC + (G + L)) + side * (c' - AP) * Q_seed on binary64; Q = decimal floor of sig10(E) / c'; E < sig10(Q * c') keeps only the close leg (the opening leg is dropped). A resting strategy.exit of the reversed position (stop, or stop + trail_points) and the new entry's own strategy.exit change nothing. Off the tie (E = cost +- 0.01) the reversal fills in full.
